description: Details of of existing, existing hatched to show demolition, and proposed plans, elevation and section drawings showing the sheer top floor level (third floor) and the mansard floor level (fourth floor) showing any changes to its external form, angle, bulk, height and/or fabric (and with the drawings annotated to show external cladding materials and also any changes to the internal floor structure between these two floor levels, detailed drawings and photographs showing those timber skirtings and architraves proposed for removal and detailed drawings showing the proposed replacement timber skirtings and architraves, detailed plan drawings confirming those areas of floorboarding to be removed and plans and written confirmation on the proposed reinstatement of timber floorboarding, detailed section drawings, plan drawings showing locations, and written descriptions confirming materials and method of installation/construction for new cornicing, detailed plan drawings and written descriptions confirming materials and method of installation/construction for new internal plaster finishes at ground to second floor levels, details of elevation drawings of the detailing of the new staircase balustrade including its materials and integration with the existing staircase, and plan drawings confirming the location of the stair flights affected and showing the positioning of the balustrade to the stair treads and plan drawings, and written descriptions confirming any fabric required to be removed to facilitate the works, for the internal pipework routes in association with the air conditioning equipment pursuant to condition 3, 5, 7, 9 & 10 of listed building dated 21st October 2024 (RN:24/04555/LBC)
